FX-SPH-001.says: The settings as they start: the drawing wrapped round a sphere half the drawing's half width in radius, in the middle, its middle column facing the viewer and its top row the top pole, lit from the upper left; it darkens round the curve, the corners round it are transparent, and the inside's far wall shows only where the drawing is not covered.

FX-SPH-003.says: Render inside: the inside alone, the far wall, the drawing seen from behind and so mirrored.

FX-SPH-004.says: Rotation Y 90: the sphere turned a quarter about its upright axis, so the drawing three quarters of the way across faces the viewer.

FX-SPH-005.says: Rotation X 30: the sphere tipped, its top towards the viewer, so the top rows come round to the front.

FX-SPH-006.says: Rotation Z 90: the sphere turned on its side, its poles left and right.

FX-SPH-007.says: Radius 100: a sphere as wide as the drawing, nearer the viewer and so running past the drawing's top and bottom.

FX-SPH-008.says: Radius 0: no sphere, so nothing is drawn and the layer is transparent.

FX-SPH-009.says: Offset [25, 50]: the sphere a quarter of the way across, seen a little from the side.

FX-SPH-010.says: Light intensity 0: the ambient light alone, every pixel the wrapped drawing at 40 per cent.

FX-SPH-011.says: Ambient 100, diffuse 0, specular 0: no shading, the wrapped drawing as it is.

FX-SPH-012.says: An orange light, metal 0: the lit side and the highlight orange; with no blue in the light, blue is the ambient's alone.

FX-SPH-013.says: Roughness 50, specular 100: a larger, duller highlight.

FX-SPH-014.says: Light height -50: the light from behind, so the side facing the viewer is darker.

FX-SPH-015.says: Light direction 90: the light from the right.

FX-SPH-016.says: Rotation Y keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4, linear: one whole turn, half way at frame 2.

FX-SPH-017.says: FX-SPH-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved, sphere and all.

FX-SPH-018.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-019.says: Radius 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-020.says: Offset [1001, 50], above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-021.says: Rotation X 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-022.says: Render "Full": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-023.says: Light color "white": not a #rrggbb colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-024.says: Metal 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-025.says: Roughness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPH-026.says: Light intensity 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
